fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects inline execution of PowerShell code from a file
fields.name: Powershell Inline Execution From A File
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "iex " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "Invoke-Expression " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "Invoke-Command " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "icm ") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "cat " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "get-content " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "type ") and tgt.process.cmdline contains " -raw"))
